svg.aria-label: Four tiers, each scaled on its own: the delivery tier scales CDN nodes for static content and global traffic; the presentation tier scales web servers for more user requests; the application tier scales application servers for business logic and compute-intensive work; the data tier scales cache nodes (Redis) and search nodes (Elasticsearch) for read and query load, the database (PostgreSQL, MySQL) adds read replicas or scales up for data growth and throughput, and object storage (S3) scales automatically as a managed service
svg.text: Each tier adds or removes its own nodes to match its own load.

g.text: Add read replicas or scale up
